const add = (a: number, b: number) => a + b;
const xs = [1, 2];
console.log(add(...xs));
console.log(add(...[1, 2, 3]));
console.log(add(...[1]));
console.log(add(...[1, "a"]));
function g(a: number, b: string) { return `${a}${b}`; }
console.log(g(...["a", 1]));
console.log(add(...[...[5, 6]]));
const t: [number, number] = [...[1, 2]];
function h<T>(a: T, b: T) { return [a, b]; }
console.log(h(...[1, "a"]));
console.log(t);
